caption: The drawing features a single, dark grey or black men's coat as its central object, depicted in a straightforward, front-facing view. The coat is double-breasted with two visible rows of buttons, a high collar with wide lapels, and pointed detail near the top of the lapels. The sleeves are long and slightly tapered with some subtle pleats visible at the shoulders. The coat also has a seam detail at the waist and long vertical lines running down from the waist to the bottom hem, indicating a fitted structure with what appear to be pleats or panels. To the upper right of the main coat, there is a faint, line-drawn sketch of the back view of the same coat, showing its outline and stitching details. The background of the drawing is a light, beige color, fading to a lighter tone towards the edges. There are no other objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Tail Coat
